title: School kip?
html_source: Referring to Stephen’s job as a substitute teacher at the boy’s school in Dalkey, which we see in the next chapter, “Nestor”. The slang word “kip” is used a few times by Mulligan in this chapter with various meanings. Here he seems to use it in a sense meaning “something that is caught or seized”, as in the money Stephen will “catch” once he’s paid for the job.
